method: Effort units are relative estimates of remaining-and-completed engineering effort per feature, including feature-specific implementation and tests. Shared workstreams cover reusable platform, integration and release acceptance only; do not double-count family implementation. Mid is judgement-based completed effort / total estimated effort, not hours or feature verification. Low/high reflect uncertainty about scope and actual completed effort. Rebaseline after upstream code audit, authenticated ROM evidence and measured implementation effort.

sharedWorkstreams.rationale: Common independent ROM/CUBE version and TOML provenance acceptance, not family-specific decoding.

Atomic copy-only cell/warp/event and cross-kind transaction rehearsal with full rollback now exists; no ownership-complete journal, persisted save/reopen or authenticated write authority. Changed-byte impact diagnostics now correlate staged edits with partial cross-bank structural ownership; no full alias proof or saved-ROM transaction. Five-kind script pointer changes now participate in shared byte-claim rollback; no global ownership proof.

Android debug APK, offline WebViewAssetLoader, SAF import/export, Back navigation, signed disposable CI candidate and bounded blob readback are implemented in part. Native import-picker ticket ownership now survives WebView reload/Activity recreation without stale callback reuse (PR #260), with JUnit and CI checks. No physical-device provider, real release signing or genuine CUBE ROM acceptance.
Shared emulator runtime regression and cross-editor compatibility infrastructure.
Shared CI, safety, fixture governance, release regression, provenance and independent acceptance reports.

Touch-first CUBE map/warp/event/script-reference queues and partial raw map rendering are present. Read-only CUBE canvas now has keyboard focus, arrow/Enter/Space cell selection through guarded click path and modular/offline parity (PR #256). Complete accessible event editing, physical-device keyboard/screen-reader and authenticated ROM acceptance remain unverified.

reassessment.scope: Only four previously partial WBS items were modestly reassessed for source/CI-backed keyboard access, BPS publication integrity, local provenance checks and native import lifecycle. No increase in six-evidence strict parity; no independent ROM/device acceptance. Original 286-unit denominator, 50% planning milestone, low-confidence bounds and upstream pin unchanged.
